/**
 * String formatting utilities for quiz building.
 */
export declare class FmtHelper {
    /**
     * Format a number (or expression) as unicode superscript — for displaying exponents.
     * @example
     * "x" + QB.fmt.power(2)      // "x²"
     * "a" + QB.fmt.power(10)     // "a¹⁰"
     * QB.fmt.power(-1)           // "⁻¹"
     */
    power(n: number): string;
    /**
     * Format a numeric value with a unit string.
     * @param value - The number or expression to format
     * @param unitStr - The unit label to append
     * @example
     * QB.fmt.unit(400, 'cm²')   // "400 cm²"
     * QB.fmt.unit(3.5, 'kg')    // "3.5 kg"
     * QB.fmt.unit(p.area, 'm²') // "12 m²"
     */
    unit(value: number | string, unitStr: string): string;
    /**
     * Format a number with thousands grouping separators.
     * Pass an explicit separator to pin the format regardless of locale.
     * Omit separator to use the current locale's convention.
     * @param n - The number to format
     * @param separator - Thousands separator character (default: locale-aware)
     * @example
     * QB.fmt.thousands(1234567, ",")  // "1,234,567"  (explicit)
     * QB.fmt.thousands(1234567, ".")  // "1.234.567"  (explicit)
     * QB.fmt.thousands(1234567)       // "1,234,567" in en-US, "1.234.567" in vi-VN
     */
    thousands(n: number, separator?: string): string;
}
